security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU unconditionally registers menvcfg/menvcfgh CSRs regardless of whether U-mode is enabled (misregistering), or fails to register them when U-mode is present, violating the spec rule that menvcfg must exist iff U-mode is supported (and menvcfgh must exist iff U-mode is supported with S-mode and XLEN=32).
security_spec.summary: menvcfg/menvcfgh CSR existence must be gated on U-mode support; unconditional registration or missing U-mode check causes guest-visible CSR presence mismatch with spec
